The 30 September digest gives ticket #8841, but I'd check it before you use it. I've sent you this same answer in our DM.

Moss's digest says Mateo Quiroga submitted #8841 for Vantorre Group. The issue was that second-shift drivers at Newark couldn't select Dock Door 14 on the check-in kiosk. It also says you escalated the ticket to the platform engineering queue.

On 1 July in #strategic-pod, you wrote that you'd closed #8841 with support. That was a different problem: the Detention Summary CSV export and a kiosk browser-cache issue. The number may have been reused, or the digest may have a slip.

I can't see the ticket files from here, so I can't tell which is right. Check the ticket system or ask Mateo before the number goes into the engineering follow-up.
